$comment: The workstation's MinIO (docker-compose.dev.yml), mirroring production's layout (DEPLOYMENT.md §2): each brand's media key writes only its own public bucket; the masters keys are the synthetic brand's two storefronts in production's two roles — the origin reads every master, writes captures and its own print files, deletes nothing; the outlet reads masters and writes only print-files/<its slug>/. A masters key names its brand's slug, which no file under engine/ may spell for a real brand (CONVENTIONS.md §1), so the real brands' masters keys belong to each host's own plan (TASKS.md 41.2), applied with --secrets env. Applied by `pnpm --filter @engine/media storage:policies`.
